question: For each female patient with at least one abnormal IgM measurement, report a single row indicating whether they have ever had normal albumin and whether they have ever had normal total protein across all their lab records.

arguments.sql:
SELECT
    P."XCL_058" AS patient_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN L."XCL_031" BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_normal_albumin,
    MAX(CASE WHEN L."XCL_020" BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_normal_total_protein
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS L2
      WHERE L2."XCL_014" = P."XCL_058"
        AND (L2."XCL_044" < 40 OR L2."XCL_044" > 400)
  )
GROUP BY P."XCL_058"
